system.description: Touch a creature, and its flesh seals in jagged patterns. It hurts more than the wounds did, and it leaves a visible scar of your god's hand.

outcomes.triumph: As Success, and the creature also ends one Persistent Damage or the Infected condition.
outcomes.success: The creature regains all its HP and is Stupefied until the end of its next turn.
outcomes.failure: The creature regains half its missing HP and is Stupefied until the end of its next turn.
outcomes.ruin: Your god's hand takes rather than gives: the creature is Stupefied and regains nothing. Roll on the Shadowblight table.
